news.title: Ramp Hits $60B Valuation With $1.85B Raise, Escalating Spend Management Arms Race
news.body: Investors poured $1.85 billion into Ramp, boosting its valuation to $60 billion and giving the company resources to accelerate product launches and global expansion. Brex and Coupa must now contend with Ramp’s increased ability to invest in AI-driven spend controls, international payments, and integrations. Expect Brex, Coupa, and other fintechs to pursue acquisitions and roll out advanced analytics or automation features to keep pace.

news.title: Amazon Eyes $7B Decart Acquisition to Accelerate AI Integration Across Commerce Stack
news.body: Amazon is negotiating to acquire AI startup Decart for about $7 billion, aiming to embed proprietary AI into its retail and payments systems. If the deal closes, Amazon could use Decart’s technology to automate supply chain decisions and personalize checkout flows, forcing Walmart and Shopify to accelerate their own AI investments or risk losing ground in customer experience and operational efficiency.

news.title: CFTC Moves to Regulate Prediction Markets by Redefining Swaps Scope
news.body: The CFTC proposed expanding the definition of swaps to cover event contracts, targeting prediction market platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket. These companies would need to overhaul compliance programs, register with the CFTC, and potentially restrict certain markets, increasing costs and limiting product variety for users. Kalshi and Polymarket must now decide whether to adapt or exit the U.S. market.

news.title: XRP Ledger Fixes Overflow Bug That Could Have Minted 18 Trillion XRP
news.body: Developers patched a decade-old overflow bug in the XRP Ledger that could have let attackers mint up to 18 trillion XRP, averting a potential collapse in token value. The fix allows exchanges like Binance and payment processors using XRP to assure enterprise clients of improved protocol security, strengthening XRP’s position against rivals like Stellar and Solana in institutional payments.

news.title: Sui Foundation Commits $30M to DATA Network, Deepening Blockchain Ecosystem Play
news.body: The Sui Foundation invested $30 million in DATA Network, which will migrate to Sui’s blockchain, expanding Sui’s reach in data and smart contract services. This positions Sui to compete more directly with Solana and Avalanche for developer adoption and enterprise partnerships, while DATA Network’s move could attract new projects to Sui’s ecosystem and intensify competition among blockchain infrastructure providers.

perspective: Ramp’s $60B raise and Amazon’s Decart talks spotlight the intensifying race for scale and AI leadership in fintech and commerce.

curiosity.text: PSD2’s requirement for banks to share customer data with licensed third parties led to some banks launching their own fintech subsidiaries to compete with new entrants.
